decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that is close to the firm's core water-infrastructure portfolio, management is likely to give this mechanically adjacent product more time and justify the recent investment despite only modest public visibility so far.

This 2024 energy management system directly supports the firm's stated move toward digitally networked, efficient, environmentally oriented infrastructure, so management is strongly inclined to continue backing it and interpret any early weakness as temporary.

Because this 2024 water-level regulation product has its own webpage and fits the firm's established infrastructure offering, the visible commitment and sunk development effort make management likely to retain it for at least another year.
